steps: Given: Time to reach highest point, t = 3 s; height above ground at which the ball was hit, h₀ = 1 m; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻² downward.
Required: Initial velocity, u; maximum height from the ground, H.
At the highest point, final velocity v = 0.
Using v = u − gt: u = v + gt.
Substitution: u = 0 m s⁻¹ + (10 m s⁻²)(3 s).
Using s = ut − ½gt², the height risen above the point of launch is: s = (30 m s⁻¹)(3 s) − ½(10 m s⁻²)(3 s)².
Maximum height from the ground: H = h₀ + s = 1 m + 45 m = 46 m.
